page_title: Platform related--Registration on the Sany department standard platform fails
page_content:
[TOC]



Why does registration on the Sany department standard platform fail?

Troubleshooting steps:

1. Log in to the Sany platform, open the vehicle maintenance information and check the license plate number, mobile phone number, terminal ID, port number (default 7000), IP address and license plate color, as shown below:

![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=2d436524874d9112904335e439e3f6e2)

2. Use the remote plug-in or the local remote control to enter the 808 menu and check whether the parameters above are all correct and whether 808 is enabled.
